turns.user: My 24-hour Budapest travelcard is valid until tonight. Can I use it on any bus?
turns.agent:
Yes, for ordinary bus services within the travelcard’s applicable area and validity—but not every bus. The 24-hour Budapest travelcard covers eligible ordinary services; it does not cover the airport express 100E. Bus 200E follows ordinary ticket/pass rules, so it is covered while your travelcard is still valid. A travelcard valid only “until tonight” won’t cover rides after its expiry.

This is based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check. See BKK’s 24-hour Budapest travelcard and airport express information for current terms. If you mean a particular bus, send its route number and I can help assess it.

turns.user: Specifically, I need to go by 100E.
turns.agent:
Your 24-hour Budapest travelcard alone does not cover 100E, and it does not qualify for the discounted 100E add-on. The snapshot lists the full-price 100E ticket at 2,500 HUF; as of the 5 November 2026 snapshot, that is the applicable option unless you independently qualify for a documented free-travel entitlement or also hold a separate eligible pass.

See BKK’s 100E airport shuttle ticket and 24-hour Budapest travelcard pages for current terms. I can explain the options, but I can’t sell or issue a ticket.
